title: Rigidbody movement basics
content: For physics-based movement in 3D, use Rigidbody and apply forces in FixedUpdate. Avoid directly setting transform position every frame when using physics.

title: CharacterController movement
content: CharacterController.Move allows non-physics character movement with collision handling. You must apply gravity manually.

title: Input System overview
content: The new Input System supports action maps and multiple control schemes. Use InputAction callbacks for decoupled controls.

title: 2D collision callbacks
content: Use OnCollisionEnter2D and OnTriggerEnter2D for 2D collision events. Ensure Rigidbody2D and Collider2D setup is correct.

title: Scene loading
content: Use SceneManager.LoadScene for immediate loading or LoadSceneAsync for non-blocking transitions and loading screens.

title: Coroutines
content: Coroutines are useful for timed logic without blocking the main thread. Yield return null waits one frame.

title: NavMesh AI movement
content: NavMeshAgent handles navigation and pathfinding on baked nav meshes. Set destination and tune speed, stopping distance, and acceleration.
